subject.title: Plugin Hooks: Missing trace context for observability (messageId, runId in all hooks, parentSpanId)

question: What public Plugin SDK trace-correlation contract should hook consumers be able to rely on across agent, message, compaction, and subagent hooks?
rationale: The remaining work is not just plumbing existing values; it defines public hook availability, field names, optionality, parent/child run semantics, and span identity guarantees across multiple hook families.

options.title: Approve a minimal unified contract
options.body: Define required/optional run, message, sender, trace, span, and requester-run fields per hook family, then implement that single contract across current runtime paths.

options.title: Land narrow slices only
options.body: Keep current partial hooks and address outbound runId, typed agent_start, and subagent requesterRunId as separate public API issues.

options.title: Defer plugin hook tracing
options.body: Treat diagnostics/OTel as the primary tracing surface and leave plugin hooks as best-effort event observations with limited correlation guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve a minimal unified contract
recommendation.body: Define required/optional run, message, sender, trace, span, and requester-run fields per hook family, then implement that single contract across current runtime paths.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest recent history across hook correlation fields and diagnostic trace carrier work.
